assignments.name: Set_Record_Name
assignments.label: Set Record Name
assignments.description: Assigns the computed Name back onto the in-flight record. Before-save flows edit $Record in place with no DML — safe and free.

Flow.description: Fundraising Quick Start: on insert or update of a GiftTransaction, sets Name to a human-readable summary derived from the donor, amount, and category. Corporate matching gifts (MatchingEmployerTransactionId is set) render as "<Employer> match - $<amt> on <TransactionDate>". Pledge payments anchor on TransactionDueDate (what is owed); one-time gifts anchor on TransactionDate. Two opt-outs: the FQS_Skip_Record_Naming custom permission (assign to integration users) and the FQS_Skip_Naming__c checkbox on the record.

formulas.name: Computed_Name
formulas.expression: IF( {!Is_Corp_Match}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " match - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " on " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}), IF( {!Is_Pledge_Payment}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " due " + TEXT( IF( ISBLANK({!$Record.TransactionDueDate}), {!$Record.TransactionDate}, {!$Record.TransactionDueDate} ) ), {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " on " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}) ))

Flow.label: FQS Auto Name Gift Transaction

recordLookups.name: Get_Donor
recordLookups.label: Get Donor
recordLookups.description: Fetches the donor Account so its Name (First + Last for Person Accounts, Organization Name for Orgs, or the corporate employer name for matching gifts) can be composed into the record Name.

start.filterFormula: NOT( {!$Permission.FQS_Skip_Record_Naming} ) && NOT( {!$Record.FQS_Skip_Naming__c} ) && NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.DonorId}) ) && NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.OriginalAmount}) ) && NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.TransactionDate}) ) && ( ISNEW() || ISCHANGED({!$Record.DonorId}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.OriginalAmount}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.TransactionDate}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.TransactionDueDate}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.MatchingEmployerTransactionId}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c}) )
